title: I’ll never get tired of the magical broadway first preview 🌆#sunsetbl...
transcript: 3 mid show standing ovations was not enough standing ovations for Sunset Boulevard, especially for Nicole Scherzinger. I was not planning to go to the first preview Sunset Boulevard. I actually have tickets to go on Wednesday, but I saw this production back in December in London and I loved it so much that I started getting a lot of FOMO at the idea of not being so at three PM when my friend texted me, hey, I've got tickets to first preview tonight if you want them. I said yes before I'd even figured out who I was going with. It ended up being my brother Axel, but I am so glad I got to be there. From the moment Nicole Scherzinger sang just one look and the entire audience rose to his feet like they could not help themselves, I knew we were in for a very special night. I could do another video on the stylistic choices Jamie Lloyd makes in the Sunset Boulevard, but tonight I was just so in awe of every single performance and the way that they can act both for stage and for screen at the same time. We finally got the mystery solved of where Tom Francis would be walking. Spoiler alert it is outside and it is so cool. There was another setting of Asian there deserve. I definitely want to watch it from outside one day. But play cool, I don't want it to get ruined. And of course Nicole, who was giving the performance of a literal lifetime. She's not afraid to be funny and goofy and over the top. She is the perfect Norman Desmond, and it is a performance. I'm so grateful I got to see her. Standing ovation for as if we never said Goodbye. Could have lasted 25 minutes and I wouldn't have complained. I love a first preview. I'm so happy the show is in New York. PS so many of my friends here in the credits. That was so cool. Anyway, can't wait to see the show again in just a few days. Welcome to Broadway, Sunset Boulevard.
reasoning: The reviewer expresses overwhelming enthusiasm for Sunset Boulevard and Nicole Scherzinger's performance, attended first preview out of FOMO after seeing it in London, praised every performance, and plans to see it again in days. Multiple moments of effusive praise with zero criticism.
